players.name: Adrian Kempe
players.inj_detail: Kempe (undisclosed) won't be in the lineup against Buffalo on Saturday, per Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site.

players.name: Matias Maccelli
players.inj_detail: Maccelli (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.

players.name: Mats Zuccarello
players.inj_detail: Zuccarello (upper body) is regarded as week-to-week, Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site reports Thursday.

players.name: Bryan Rust
players.inj_detail: Rust (lower body) will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Michelle Crechiolo of the Penguins' official site reports Thursday.

players.name: Zemgus Girgensons
players.inj_detail: Girgensons (lower body) won't play against Nashville on Saturday, per Lightning reporter Gabby Shirley.

players.name: Jiri Kulich
players.inj_detail: Kulich has been placed in concussion protocol, per Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Monday.

players.name: Warren Foegele
players.inj_detail: Foegele (knee) will miss 3-4 weeks, Jackson Starr of the Senators' official site reports Saturday.

players.name: Mike Matheson
players.inj_detail: Matheson (lower body) is expected to miss two weeks, Renaud Lavoie of TVA Sports reports Saturday.

players.name: Andre Burakovsky
players.inj_detail: Burakovsky (lower body) is expected to miss the next 3-4 weeks, Jackson Starr of the Senators' official site reports Saturday.

players.name: Radek Faksa
players.inj_detail: Faksa (lower body) will likely miss another week, according to Owen Newkirk of DLLS Sports on Tuesday.

players.name: Oskar Bäck
players.inj_detail: Back was placed on long-term injured reserve on Saturday.

players.name: Justin Danforth
players.inj_detail: Danforth (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Thursday, per the NHL media site.

players.name: Erik Cernak
players.inj_detail: Cernak (undisclosed) won't be in the lineup against Nashville on Saturday, according to Lightning reporter Gabby Shirley.

players.name: Nick Blankenburg
players.inj_detail: Blankenburg (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Maple Leafs on Friday, David Alter of The Hockey News reports.

players.name: Albert Johansson
players.inj_detail: Head coach Todd McLellan said Friday that Johansson (undisclosed) will miss at least three more games, Ansar Khan of MLive.com reports.

players.name: Josh Manson
players.inj_detail: Manson (ankle) is expected to miss the next eight weeks, Corey Masisak of The Denver Post reports Friday.
